_: Editorial for polo-blackout. Fabric, fit, size guide, marquee, closing CTA and cross-sell come from _family-polo-blade.json.
_specs: The design name comes from the Shopify image filename, the only record of what the print is. Nothing about the artwork is invented.
buyBody: All black, blade collar, no buttons. The plainest shirt in the range and the one most likely to be worn twice a week.
pieceParas: Black, with the stroke-play pattern worked in dark enough that you only find it in direct light. Nothing at the neck, nothing on the chest.
It is the default. If you own one Lucky shirt and you want it to disappear into everything else you own, this is that shirt.
lifestyleBrief: Portrait 4:5, on body. Raking side light is mandatory — the pattern is tonal and in flat light this photographs as a plain black shirt, which undersells it. There is no on-body apparel photography at all yet (HANDOFF §7b F).
